L13·N9818unmasked layer
This neuron is essentially a sentence-boundary detector with inverted sign: it is strongly *suppressed* by clause/post-final punctuation (".", "!", newline closing a thought in forum-style text) and weakly *activated* on mid-sentence continuation tokens in informal conversational prose (pronouns like " I", " my", " are", a noun completing a phrase, or an exclamation mark that is immediately continued).
